meta.titleBase: BKC Yume — Parfait Food Truck in Joetsu & Myoko, Niigata
meta.description: Parfait food truck touring Joetsu, Myoko & Itoigawa in Niigata. Seasonal parfaits ¥800–¥1,000 with artisan, not-too-sweet whipped cream. See our next pop-up.
meta.tagline: See it, love it ♡ Taste it, love it ♡

hero.body: Artisan whipped cream, not too sweet. Seasonal fruit at its peak. BKC Yume rolls into your town.

aboutExcerpt.heading: Our signature: BLACK.
aboutExcerpt.body: A jet-black parfait colored with bamboo charcoal cream. Low sugar, quietly bitter, built for grown-up palates. This is the face of BKC Yume.

schedule.heading: Pop-ups
schedule.sub: Up-to-date schedule also lives on Instagram.

origin.title: The name
origin.body: "Yume" means dream — small, warm moments that make people smile. We carry a pink dream on the black body of a BLACK KITCHEN CAR.

cream.title: The cream
cream.body: Low sugar, lifted by dairy aroma. Temperature-controlled for clean melt and crisp finish. The cream supports the fruit, never fights it.

maker.title: The maker
maker.body: Every parfait finished in front of you. Seeing our guests' faces while we build — that's the joy of a food truck.
